title: Power Pages: security agent in design studio configures authentication and authorisation
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, approval requirement and security scan endpoint are supported. Minor corrections should clarify the product-level licensing entitlement, complete the two abbreviated control paths and make the cost rationale explicitly describe missing documentation rather than an assurance of no charge.

claims.quote: "targetDate": "November CY2026"

claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: As you work on projects and need to establish permanent sites that don't expire, you can apply Power Pages subscriptions and convert websites from trial to production.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Set the notes to: 'The design-studio capability sits within Power Pages; the product licensing page describes Power Pages subscriptions for permanent sites and a free trial. No separate security-agent licence or consumption model is published as of November 2026. Confirm before general availability.' Keep https://learn.microsoft.com/power-pages/go-live/assign-licensing as the source.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The roadmap, preview documentation and cited product licensing page specify no separate security-agent licence.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages security agent licensing Copilot Credits pricing consumption; "Power Pages" "security agent" "license". Read the roadmap, security/security-agent, faq-security-agent and go-live/assign-licensing; none specifies a separate agent licence.
claims.fix: Replace the cost rationale sentence 'The roadmap and Learn pages state no separate licence or meter' with 'The roadmap and preview documentation do not specify a separate security-agent licence or meter as of November 2026'. This records an absence, not a statement that use is free.

claims.claim: The tenant publishing control is in Power Platform admin center at Manage > Tenant settings > Publish Copilots with AI features.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. In the Manage pane, select Tenant settings. ... Publish Copilots with AI features ... Allows Copilot authors to publish from Copilot Studio when AI features are enabled.

claims.claim: An automation call for the Publish Copilots with AI features tenant control is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Publish Copilots with AI features" PowerShell tenantsettings API; "Publish Copilots" "Set-TenantSettings"; "enableOpenAiBotPublishing" publish tenant PowerShell. Read tenant-settings and list-tenantsettings; the similarly named property is explicitly unused.

claims.claim: The tenant publishing control governs site chatbot publishing.
claims.quote: Chat agent (site Copilot) specific setting: If the setting for “Publish bots with AI” is disabled at the tenant level, admins are unable to configure site Copilot at the environment level.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that the site-chatbot publishing control applies to the security agent.
claims.quote: Searched: "Publish Copilots with AI features" PowerShell tenantsettings API; "Power Pages" "security agent" "disable". Read tenant-settings, copilot-hub, copilot-governance and security/security-agent; the publishing rule names site Copilot, not the maker security assistant.

claims.claim: Power Pages environment AI settings are reached through Power Platform admin center > Copilot Hub > Power Pages > Settings.
claims.quote: To view or update these settings, navigate to Copilot hub > Power Pages > Settings in the Power Platform admin center.
claims.fix: The path reaches the correct settings page but stops before the setting. Extend it to 'Copilot Hub > Power Pages > Settings > Power Pages > feature > environment > Set up/Edit > Set up > option', following the cited Admin experience instructions; the second Power Pages is the product filter and option is the applicable choice on the Set up page.

claims.claim: A control-specific automation call for the Power Pages maker AI environment setting is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages maker AI settings API/PowerShell/pac admin; EnvironmentManagementSetting Update. Read copilot-hub, SDK model, SettingsPatchRequestBody, CLI environment-management and REST update-environment-management-settings; the PATCH body specifies no deciding property.
